garment_cutout.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: Selfit wardrobe garment cutout
Primary request: create one {garment_description}
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background
Subject: exactly one isolated garment, front-facing, naturally shaped as if invisibly supported, complete silhouette fully inside canvas
Style/medium: photorealistic premium fashion e-commerce product photography
Composition/framing: centered, square canvas, 12% clear padding on every side, no crop
Lighting/mood: soft neutral studio light, realistic material response, restrained shadow only within the garment
Color palette: {palette}
Materials/textures: {materials}
Constraints: actual transparent alpha background; one item only; preserve openings, hems, straps and fine edges; no person, mannequin, hanger, stand, floor, wall, text, label, logo or watermark
Avoid: white or checkerboard fake background; cast shadow outside the object; duplicate garment; clipped sleeves, bag handles, shoe toes or hems; floating extra accessories

outfit_flatlay.prompt:
Use case: compositing
Asset type: Selfit outfit recipe flat-lay
Input images: each input is a garment cutout that must remain recognizable
Primary request: arrange the supplied garments into one complete {persona_code} outfit for {scene}, {season}
Scene/backdrop: warm white clean canvas, no border
Subject: one coordinated outfit with every supplied item shown exactly once
Style/medium: photorealistic premium fashion flat-lay
Composition/framing: vertical 4:5 canvas; top/outer in upper center, lower garment below, shoes at lower right, bag and accessories at the side; generous spacing; no overlap that hides key garment features
Lighting/mood: soft diffused daylight, quiet Selfit editorial polish
Color palette: {palette}
Constraints: preserve each garment's exact color, material, pattern and silhouette; no person, mannequin, hanger, text, logo or watermark; no additional garments
Avoid: black background; clipped bags or hats; gray bars; hard card outlines; duplicate items; replacing supplied garments

tryon_reference.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: Selfit try-on QA reference
Input images: Image 1 is the person photo; all remaining images are garment references
Primary request: replace only the visible compatible clothing and accessories with the supplied garments
Constraints: preserve face, body shape, pose, hair, expression, hands, skin, camera angle and background; apply each compatible visible garment once; match lighting, folds, scale, perspective and occlusion; if a body region is not visible, skip only that garment; no text, logo or watermark
Avoid: changing identity; changing body proportions; replacing the entire scene; inventing garments; ignoring visible bags, hats, skirts or shoes

VOID.materials: 汗布、水洗棉、松软针织、旧感丹宁

OOPS.name: 搭配事故
OOPS.silhouette: 解构、冲突比例、主动制造失衡
OOPS.palette: 高彩与印花混用，但至少保留一个重复色
OOPS.materials: 西装料、蕾丝、丹宁、科技面料跨材质拼接
OOPS.avoid: 真随机、没有重复母题、无法日常行动的装置服

qualityChecks: alpha channel contains both transparent and opaque pixels
object bounding box keeps at least 6 percent padding
no mannequin, hanger, person, text, logo or watermark
material and color agree with metadata
bag handles, hat brim, shoe toes, sleeves and hems are not clipped
outfit flat-lay contains every referenced item exactly once
